blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) said it will be on full alert nationwide from Oct. 30 to Nov. 2 ahead of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or Undas, with over 140,000 personnel from various agencies deployed for security. A total of 72,501 cops have been deployed, along with 16,892 personnel from the Armed Forces of the Philippines, Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine Coast Guard, and other agencies. They will be supported by 51,467 force multipliers, including barangay tanods, radio groups, and other nongovernment organizations. “These will be our personnel who will be guarding our thoroughfares, cemeteries, […]...
